name: io.github.Apophisss/minion
title: Minion
description: Featherweight Linux desktops for AI agents: read the screen as text, click, type, run any app.

packageArguments.description: Runs the MCP server on stdio. Optional flags after it: --compact (one `computer` tool, about 450 tokens of tool definitions instead of 3,300) and --no-images (text only, for clients that pass images to the model as base64 text). Desktops need Docker, OrbStack or Podman.

Runs the MCP server on stdio, with the same optional flags (--compact, --no-images). The npm package is a small launcher that runs the PyPI package of the same version with uvx or pipx, so it needs uv or pipx. Desktops need Docker, OrbStack or Podman.
